messages.text: How do I transfer my 7,200,000 bolts to the bots store. I hit the jackpot and went to the bolt store to redeem, but my bolts aren't there.

I bought a Bobcat Helium miner from Helium Deploy sometime back in 2021 or 2022. When I enter my email address I still have and used back then on the Harlo site to confirm I am a customer, it doesn't recognize my email.  Why?
Handed to the team · Don't know how Harlo's customer check looks up HeliumDeploy buyers; won't guess.

I've checked your order history. You are a HeliumDeploy customer under that email. Your Bobcat Miner 300 order is Shop····, delivered November 24, 2021. You also have order Shop···· for two SyncroB.It miners, delivered January 19, 2022.

I can't tell from here why the Harlo site doesn't find that email, and I'd rather not guess. I've sent the team both order numbers and your Bolts question so they can get you recognised. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you their answer.
I just tried again, and the Harlo site still doesn't recognize my email address.  I received the code (finally), entered it, and it says can't find a qualified purchase from this email address.

Thanks for trying again. That message tells us the code worked and the lookup is the problem. The Harlo site found your email but didn't count anything under it as a qualifying purchase.

Your purchases are definitely on our side under that email: the Bobcat Miner 300 (Shop····) and the two SyncroB.It miners (Shop····). I can't see which purchases the Harlo check counts, and I won't guess. Older Helium hotspot orders might not be included, but I can't confirm that.

The team already has your ticket, and your latest message with that error is on it. Someone will pick it up and email you their answer.
You have mentioned several times through this chat over the past week or more that someone would be contacting me via email to resolve my issues, and I haven't received anything yet.
Handed to the team · Customer has been told for over a week that someone would email him, and nobody

You're right, and I'm sorry. You were told more than once over the past week or more that someone would email you, and nobody has. That isn't good enough.

I've now flagged your ticket as overdue. It has both open questions on it: why the Harlo check can't find a qualifying purchase on your email even though your 2021 orders are there, and your Bolts question. Someone on the team will pick it up and email you at the address you gave this chat.

You haven't received anything yet, but it's still worth checking your spam folder for mail from HeliumDeploy.
